A note from the heart

Dear Nne,
you are magic.

On this beautiful day, the universe pauses to celebrate one of its finest creations — you, Glory Chenbap.

You carry something rare inside you: a warmth that draws people in, a mind that sees through things clearly, and a spirit that refuses to be diminished by anything.

Nne, you walk into a room and rearrange the atmosphere. Your dreams are not small. They are the size of courtrooms not yet entered, of continents not yet explored, of laughter not yet shared.

May this birthday be the beginning of everything extraordinary you deserve. May every door you push open welcome you with grace, and may every road you travel take you somewhere wonderful.

Here is to you, in all your glory. Literally.

With so much love and admiration
